lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Grandma [beat] you can’t just hand me the keys to a nitro-boosted scooter and expect me not to freak out in front of the whole family!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Stop shaking like a wet leaf [beat] because being the Scooter Heir isn't about the speed [beat] it’s about the secret cargo you're carrying.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I knew it [beat] I always told everyone that Nani’s midnight rides weren't for exercise [beat] she’s been running a black-market candy ring!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: A candy ring? [beat] Please [beat] my mother is much more sophisticated than that [beat] she’s actually the fastest courier in the tri-state area.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait [beat] so the legendary Midnight Scooter wasn't just for stunts [beat] you were actually delivering Mrs. Haque’s secret spicy pickles to the governor?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: The governor [beat] the mayor [beat] even your principal [beat] they all pay a premium for discreet deliveries when the local shops are closed.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: This is insane [beat] our grandmother is literally the underworld queen of snacks [beat] and now she’s passing the throne to Nix?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don't even have a license [beat] and you want me to navigate the back alleys of the city [beat] while balancing three crates of vintage soda?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: You have the reflexes of a ninja [beat] and besides [beat] the scooter is registered as a mobility aid [beat] so the police can't even pull you over.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I’m calling the neighborhood watch right now [beat] because this kind of illegal snacking operation is ruining the moral fabric of our street!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Go ahead [beat] but remember that I have footage of you [beat] buying three extra-large tubs of chocolate ice cream at three in the morning.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I guess the helmet fits [beat] so if anyone needs a midnight delivery [beat] just look for the kid blurring past your window at eighty miles per hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that’s how Nix became the most powerful teenager in the neighborhood [beat] one high-speed snack delivery at a time.
